title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 4 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt:
In spite of the advances made in agriculture, many people around the world still go hungry.

Why is this the case?

What can be done about this problem?
scenario: In spite of the advances made in agriculture, many people around the world still go hungry.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
